title: BlockChat
tagline: Real-time on-chain chat app powered by MUD, with customizable username and profile picture
description: I used MUD with a couple of tables, one for users and the other for messages. Users can change their display name and picture by updating the users table through the UI. All messages are stored in a global messages table. Blockchat is based on the vite + react MUD template and is deployed in the Lattice testnet.
how_its_made:
I used only MUD, no other sponsor technologies were used. 
I used MUD with a couple of tables, one for users and the other for messages. Users can change their display name and picture by updating the users table through the UI. All messages are stored in a global messages table. Blockchat is based on the vite + react MUD template and is deployed in the Lattice testnet.
